commission: Give Vlad fast access to every known Judgment Jar through Home Center, record a typed receipt for every Jar use describing the output it created, and remove Command Center as an active surface or architectural claim.

missionBoundary.forbiddenSubstitution: Command Center is not an active surface and must not be introduced as a fourth control plane.
missionBoundary.syncOwner: existing vlad-swarm daemon via the existing vlad-jars sync heartbeat
missionBoundary.delivery: repository implementation and durable receipts; runtime deployment remains a separate capability state

research.existingReceiptGap: Atom records only local context-access receipts and falsely labels them Home Center DELIVERED. CLI prompt/get/source and Venice review outputs are not uniformly typed or force-fed to a Home Center ledger.
research.homeCenterWriteLane: Home Center MCP drive_operation supports docs.create, docs.update appendText, docs.read, drive.search, and drive.read_metadata.
research.daemonSeam: tools/vlad_swarm_daemon.py already calls vlad-jars sync on heartbeat, so receipt flushing belongs inside the existing sync command rather than a second watcher.

selectedJudgmentJars.reason: Preserve Home Center, Judgment Jars, and Vlad as the commissioned surfaces and reject Command Center substitution.
Separate repository implementation from deployed or callable phone behavior.
Extend the existing registry, sync heartbeat, and receipt service instead of inventing parallel infrastructure.
Queue receipts on transient failure and retry without losing output provenance.
Use oldest-first durable outbox, bounded retry, and the existing daemon heartbeat.

plan: Add a shared Python receipt/outbox module that validates output kinds, captures Jar identity, actor, intent, decision/action, input/output digests, and provenance.

Make vlad-jars get, source, and prompt emit context_packet receipts; add an explicit receipt command for answer, plan, decision, code change, test, review, artifact, handoff, execution, blocker, no-change, and mixed outputs.
Flush pending receipts to one append-only native Home Center document from the existing vlad-jars sync heartbeat, verifying every append by Home Center readback.
Correct Atom local receipt states so local capture is not mislabeled as Home Center delivery.
Instrument Venice plan/completion review entrypoints to record review_verdict output receipts for every selected/applied Jar.
Update Vlad, Jar, Atom, and bootstrap doctrine so Command Center is explicitly nonexistent and every Jar use requires a typed output receipt.
Add deterministic tests for validation, deduplication, oldest-first retry, Home Center readback, CLI receipt creation, and Atom receipt state truth.
antagonism: A second watcher would violate the commission; flushing must ride the existing vlad-jars sync heartbeat.
A local JSONL receipt is not Home Center delivery; CAPTURED, PENDING_HOME_CENTER, and DELIVERED must remain distinct.
Recording only Jar lookup would not reveal what the Jar produced; context_packet access and final output receipts are distinct events.
A Home Center append without readback can duplicate after an ambiguous network failure; dedup fingerprints and source readback are required.

Renaming every historical command_center symbol would be an unrelated broad migration; only active user-facing contracts in this slice are corrected, while historical compatibility identifiers remain explicitly non-authoritative.
Receipt failure must not erase the work product; it must queue the receipt and surface pending delivery honestly.

output.summary: Venice allowed the bounded typed-receipt and Home Center sync implementation without a duplicate watcher.

note: Proceed with the existing Vlad/Home Center/Jar architecture, fail closed on false delivery claims, and do not claim runtime deployment from repository commits.
